title: .craft-config.yml (v4)
description: Craftsman plugin configuration. YAML file validated against this schema by /craftsman:healthcheck and CI. See ADR-0021.

v.description: Config format version. v4 configs must declare v: 4; older configs are migrated by /craftsman:setup.

packs.description: Comma-separated pack names, or a mapping with an external list.

session_start_max_chars.description: Hard cap on session-start injection. 0 disables the injection entirely.

max_learned_skills.description: Maximum learned-instinct skills surfaced per session (ADR-0020).

disabled.description: Hook ids to disable, e.g. [bias-detector, agent-sentry-context]. Inline YAML list form.

rules.description: Rule overrides, short form (PHP001: warn) or long form. See rules engine docs.
